ex.t: 象征主义是使用一个对象来代表一个抽象的想法。

ex.s: I shaped individual letters into repeating lines, which were abstract forms, delightful but meaningless patterns.
ex.t: 我把单个字母塑造成重复的线条，那是抽象的形式，令人愉悦但毫无意义的图案。

ex.s: Most of my reading through primary， middle and high school was factual reading． I read for knowledge， and to make A's on my tests． Occasionally， I would read a novel that was assigned， but I didn't enjoy this type of reading． I liked facts， things that are concrete． I thought anything abstract left too much room for argument．
ex.t: 在小学、初中和高中阶段，我的大部分阅读都是事实性阅读。我为获取知识而读，为了在考试中拿A。偶尔，我也会读老师指定的小说，但我并不喜欢这种阅读。我喜欢事实，喜欢具体的东西。我认为任何抽象的事物都留下了太多争论的空间。
